location: House of Healing : Carried by Sister Hunna
damage: 1H 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier Slashing  ·  2H 1d10 + 1 (2~11) + Strength modifier Slashing

name: Bonespike Boots
summary: Bonespike Boots are a Very rare pair of Boots that enhances jump distance and gives the character access to the Brutal Leap ability.
location: Western Beach : In wooden chest in a secluded passageway at the far end of the western trail leading away from the South Span Checkpoint in Rivington

special.d: Leap at a target and possibly knock it Prone. (Recharge: Per turn.)

name: Bonespike Garb
summary: Bonespike Garb is a very rare piece of Clothing that grants temporary hit points when using Rage, and reduces incoming damage by 2. Attackers receive Piercing damage when the wearer is struck.
location: Rivington General : Sold by Exxvikyap in Rivington during Act Three

special.d: You gain 15 temporary hit points whenever you Rage.

name: Bonespike Gloves
summary: Bonespike Gloves is a pair of very rare gloves. They allow the wearer's attacks to ignore Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage.
location: Lower City Sewers : Worn by Strangler Luke during the quest Get Orin's Netherstone

special.d: Your attacks ignore Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage.

name: Bonespike Helmet
summary: Bonespike Helmet is a very rare Helmet. If the wearer rages, the helmet forces all hostile creatures within a 3m radius to roll a wisdom saving throw. Those failing this roll take 2-8 Psychic damage; a successful roll halves this.
location: Lower City Sewers : Sold by Voiceless Penitent Bareki

special.d: Possibly Frighten your target. They'll have Disadvantage on ability checks and Attack Rolls and be unable to move. (Recharge: Per turn.)

name: BOOOAL's Arms
summary: BOOOAL's Arms is a common variant of the Javelins family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile.
location: Equipped by the Kuo-toa in the Underdark within The Festering Cove

name: Boots of Aid and Comfort
summary: Boots of Aid and Comfort are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant additional Temporary Hit Points to creatures healed by the wearer.
location: Goblin Camp : Sold by Grat the Trader

special.d: When the wearer heals a target, it gains an additional 3 temporary hit points.

name: Boots of Apparent Death
summary: Boots of Apparent Death are a rare set of Boots that grants the wearer the ability to cast Feign Death once per Short Rest.
location: Reithwin Graveyard : In a sarcophagus behind the locked grated iron doors

special.d: Cast as a level 3 spell (Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Boots of Arcane Bolstering
summary: Boots of Arcane Bolstering is a pair of rare Boots that grants Arcane Charge each time the wearer Dashes, adding +1 bonus to damage with spells while Threatened.
location: Moonrise Towers : Sold by Araj Oblodra on the main floor • Lower City : Sold by Araj Oblodra in Crimson Draughts if not acquired from her in Act Two

special.d: Each time they Dash, the wearer gains Arcane Charge for 2 turns.

name: Boots of Brilliance
summary: Boots of Brilliance are a rare pair of Boots that allow the wearer to replenish one Bardic Inspiration charge once per long rest.
location: Gauntlet of Shar : In a heavy chest in the room just north of Yurgir

special.d: Play your instrument to restore one of your Bardic Inspiration slots. (Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Boots of Elemental Momentum
summary: The Boots of Elemental Momentum are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant Momentum whenever the wearer deals elemental damage with a spell or cantrip.
location: Rosymorn Monastery Trail : Sold by Lady Esther, north-east of the Trielta Crags waypoint

special.d: Whenever the wearer deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage with Spells or Cantrip, they gain Momentum for 2 turns.

name: Boots of Genial Striding
summary: Boots of Genial Striding is a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to move over difficult terrain without impediment.
location: Ebonlake Grotto : Sold by Blurg

special.d: The wearer's Movement Speed is unimpeded by Difficult Terrain.

name: Boots of Persistence
summary: Boots of Persistence is a pair of Boots that grant their wearer permanent Freedom of Movement and Longstrider effects.
location: Forge of the Nine : Sold by Dammon in the Lower City

special.d: You gain Freedom of Movement and Longstrider.

name: Boots of Psionic Movement
summary: Boots of Psionic Movement are a very rare pair of Boots that allow Githyanki wearers to fly, and enhances their attacks with Psychic damage.
location: Knights of the Shield Hideout : Worn by Ch'r'ai Har'rak

special.d: Cast as a level 3 spell (Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Boots of Speed
summary: The Boots of Speed is a pair of rare Boots that allows the wearer to click their heels for a burst of speed that makes it difficult for enemies to land Attacks of Opportunity on them.
location: Ebonlake Grotto : Worn by Thulla

special.d: Click the heels of your boots to gain speed and freedom of movement.

name: Boots of Stormy Clamour
summary: Boots of Stormy Clamour are an uncommon pair of Boots that inflict the Reverberation condition on a creature when afflicting it with another condition.
location: Ebonlake Grotto : Sold by Omeluum after completing the quest Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite

special.d: When the wearer inflicts a condition upon a hostile creature, they also inflict 2 turns of Reverberation.

name: Boots of Striding
summary: The Boots of Striding are an uncommon pair of Boots that grants the wearer a burst of speed whenever they begin concentrating on a spell.
location: Shattered Sanctum : Worn by Minthara

special.d: When you cast a spell that requires Concentration, you gain Momentum for 1 turn. While you are concentrating, you cannot be knocked Prone or moved against your will.

name: Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo
summary: The Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo are a rare pair of Boots that add the wearer's Wisdom modifier to their Unarmed Strike damage.
location: Astral Plane : Carried by Prelate Lir'i'c, as entering Act Three

special.d: The wearer deals additional damage equal to their Wisdom Modifier with unarmed strikes.

name: Boots of Very Fast Blinking
summary: Boots of Very Fast Blinking are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant the wearer the ability to cast Misty Step once per turn, but with the drawback that their clothes are left behind.
location: Circus of the Last Days : Given as a consolation prize by Akabi after failing to win the jackpot at the Wheel of Fortune

special.d: You teleport to an unoccupied space you can see. However, your clothes do not teleport with you. (Recharge: Per turn.)

name: Bow of Awareness
summary: Bow of Awareness is an uncommon +1 Shortbow that boosts the wielder's Initiative.
location: Shattered Sanctum : Sold by Roah Moonglow, to the left beyond the sanctum entrance

special.d: You gain a +1 bonus to Initiative rolls.

name: Bow of the Banshee
summary: Bow of the Banshee is a rare +1 shortbow which can frighten targets on hit and grants bonuses to weapon damage and attack rolls against Frightened creatures.
location: Carried by Corsair Greymon while the party first travel on Gekh's raft across the lake to Grymforge • Sold by Corsair Greymon at Grymforge at after the party sail there for the first time

special.d: On a hit, possibly inflict Frightened (DC 12 Wisdom Saving Throw). Gain a +1d4 bonus to attack and damage against Frightened creatures.

name: Bracers of Defence
summary: Bracers of Defence are a rare pair of Gloves which increase the wearer's Armour Class by 2 when unarmoured and not holding a shield.
location: Apothecary's Cellar : In a gilded chest in the secret cellar area of the Apothecary, beneath the Blighted Village

special.d: You gain a +2 bonus to Armour Class as long as you are not wearing armour or holding a shield.

name: Bracing Band
summary: The Bracing Band is an uncommon Ring which makes the wearer more difficult to hit after they shove an enemy.
location: Grymforge : Rewarded by Sergeant Thrinn after returning her boots in the quest Find the Missing Boots

special.d: After shoving an enemy[See Notes], the wearer gains a +1 to their Armour Class until their next turn.

name: Braindrain Cape
summary: Braindrain Cape is a rare Cloak that exhausts attackers with mental fatigue.

special.d: When the wearer succeeds a Saving Throw against any foe's spells or actions, that foe gains Mental Fatigue.

name: Braindrain Gloves
summary: Braindrain Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that inflicts Mental Fatigue on a foe whenever the wearer deals Psychic damage to them.
location: Mind Flayer Colony : On a skeleton in the Necrotic Laboratory, next to the Blade of Oppressed Souls

special.d: When you deal Psychic damage, you also inflict Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

name: Brass Locket
summary: Brass Locket is an Amulet and a Story Item.
location: In a chest inside the Tiefling Hideout in the Druid Grove

name: Brass Locket (Common)
summary: Brass Locket is a common Amulet without any enchantments.
location: Lady Jannath's Estate : in the ashes of the fireplace on the ground floor

name: Breaching Pikestaff
summary: Breaching Pikestaff is a rare +2 Pike that deals an additional 1d4 Force on each successful hit.
location: Ancient Lair : On a coffin in the center of the tomb

name: Breastplate
summary: This standard-sized breastplate is lined with thick padding meant to cushion the wearer and deflect blows from assailants. The uniform squares of the padding suggest a mathematically-mind crafter.
location: Creche Y'llek : Sold by A'jak'nir Jeera

name: Breastplate +1
summary: Breastplate +1 is an uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Piercing damage.
location: Emerald Grove : On crate near Dammon in the The Hollow • Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is between levels 6 and 8

special.d: You take 1 less Piercing damage.

name: Breastplate +2
summary: Breastplate +2 is a rare Medium Armour that reduces Piercing damage and grants a +1 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks.
location: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is level 9 or above

special.d: You take 1 less Piercing damage.

name: Brewing Ladle
summary: A skillful smith decorated the wooden handle with a fine golden filigree.

name: Brimmed Hat
summary: Brimmed Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.
location: Found as random loot throughout the game. • This item can be found in a Backpack on the Ravaged Beach.

name: Briskwind Boots
summary: The Briskwind Boots is a rare pair of Boots that allows the wearer to regain all movement speed upon landing a critical hit or killing a hostile creature.

special.d: After scoring a Critical Hit or killing a hostile creature, movement speed is restored to maximum.

name: Broken Club
summary: Broken Club is a mundane, nonmagical variant of the Clubs family of weapons. It is a Simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.
location: The Risen Road : In the Toll House basement

name: Broken Padded Armour
summary: Broken Padded Armour is a common Light Armour.
location: Risen Road Toll House: On a shelf in the basement

name: Broken Pike
summary: Broken Pike is a common variant of the Pikes family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that's wielded with both hands. It gives the user extra reach in melee combat.
location: Impaled into the ground within the Shadowfell

name: Broken Shield
summary: The Broken Shield is a common Shield that is severly damaged, providing less AC than regular shields.
location: In areas where old battles have occurred, such as in the Gauntlet of Shar and the Shadowfell

name: Broken spear
summary: Broken spear refers the following two items that can be obtained in Act One's Wilderness.

name: Bronze Necklace
summary: A Bronze Necklace is a common Amulet. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.
location: Random loot from chests and characters

name: Bronze Pendant
summary: Bronze Pendant is a common Amulet. It has no enchantments.
location: The Glitter Gala : On a display table

name: Bronze Ring
summary: A Bronze Ring describes a variety of common Ring, primarily of value for use in trading or bartering with vendors.
location: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Broodmother's Revenge
summary: The Broodmother's Revenge is an uncommon Amulet. It coats the wearer's weapon in poison for 2 turns whenever they are healed.
location: Inner Sanctum : Carried by Kagha in the Emerald Grove • High Hall : On a table of goods, owned by Koll

special.d: Whenever the wearer is healed, their weapon becomes coated in magic and deals an additional 1d6Poison damage.

name: Browbeaten Circlet
summary: Browbeaten Circlet is an uncommon piece of Headwear that grants the wearer a bonus to spell save DC while being threatened.
location: Moonrise Towers Prison : in the evidence chest on the top floor of the Warden's tower

special.d: The wearer gains a +1 bonus to spell save DC while Threatened.

name: Burnished Necklace
summary: Burnished Necklace is an unenchanted Amulet found as random loot.
location: Aboard the Nautiloid in the Prologue  • Random loot throughout the game

name: Burnished Ring
summary: The Burnished Ring is a very rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast Paralyzing Ray once per Long Rest.
location: House of Hope : Carried by Spectator in Hope's prison

special.d: Cast as a level 3 spell (Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Bycocket
summary: Bycocket is a common Non-Armour Headwear.
location: Can be found on a table behind Gloomy Fentonson in Baldur's Gate. • Cloister of Sombre Embrace : On a shelf in the Infiltration Training room.

name: Cacophony
summary: Cacophony is a rare +1 Quarterstaff that grants the wielder the Thunderous Smite spell.
location: Rosymorn Monastery Trail : Sold by Lady Esther, north-east of the Trielta Crags waypoint
damage: 1H 1d6 + 1 (2~7) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning  ·  2H 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning  ·  Extra 1d4 (1~4) Thunder

special.d: Cast as a level 1 spell (Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Caitiff Staff
summary: Caitiff Staff is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) special variant of the Quarterstaves family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.
location: Devil's Fee : Sold by Helsik once her special stock is unlocked
damage: 1H 1d6 + 2 (3~8) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning  ·  2H 1d8 + 2 (3~10) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning

special.d: Replenish 1 expended Warlock spell slots. (Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Callous Glow Ring
summary: Callous Glow Ring is an uncommon Ring that deals an additional 2 Radiant damage whenever the wearer deals damage to illuminated creatures.
location: Gauntlet of Shar : in an opulent chest in the vault room near Balthazar

special.d: The wearer deals an additional 2 points of Radiant damage against creatures that are illuminated.

name: Camp Clothing
summary: Camp Clothing is a special type of Equipment each character wears by default while at the Campsite.

name: Cap and Bells
summary: Cap and Bells is a common Non-Armour Headwear.
location: Circus of the Last Days : In a chest inside a blue tent opposite of the clown stage.

name: Cap of Curing
summary: The Cap of Curing is an uncommon Hat that heals those inspired by the wearer using Bardic Inspiration.
location: Sacred Pool : In a locked gilded chest behind a pillar near to where Alfira is composing her song in the Emerald Grove

special.d: When you inspire an ally using Bardic Inspiration, they also regain 1d6Hit Points.

name: Cap of Wrath
summary: The Cap of Wrath is a rare Helmet that grants the wearer Wrath when they start the turn with 50% Hit Points or less.
location: Grymforge : Carried by Thudd

special.d: During combat, when the wearer starts their turn with 50% Hit Points or less, they gain Wrath for 2 turns.

name: Cape of the Red Prince
summary: Cape of the Red Prince is a common Cloak.
location: In the Peculiar Clothing Chest in the Traveller's Chest at the Campsite

name: Carnelian Ring
summary: An Carnelian Ring is a common Ring. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to Traders.
location: In chests and carried by characters throughout the game

name: Caustic Band
summary: Caustic Band is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer 2 Acid damage with weapon attacks.
location: Ebonlake Grotto : Sold by Derryth Bonecloak in the Underdark

special.d: Your weapon attacks also deal 2Acid damage.

name: Cemetery-Blue Torch
summary: The Cemetery-Blue Torch can be used as a Light Source or as an improvised club. It can be wielded as a simple melee weapon in one hand. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual wield without special training. It can ignite flammable surfaces or clouds if it makes contact.
location: Felogyr's Fireworks : in a chest in the basement

name: Cerebral Citadel Armour
summary: Cerebral Citadel Armour is a rare Heavy Armour. If the wearer is infested by a mind flayer tadpole, it grants them immunity to being Frightened and gives a +1 bonus to all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
location: Knights of the Shield Hideout : in a wardrobe during the quest Visit the Emperor's Old Hideout

special.d: You can't be Frightened

name: Cerebral Citadel Gloves
summary: The Cerebral Citadel Gloves are rare gloves that provide a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws when the wearer Charms or Frightens a creature.
location: Knights of the Shield Hideout : In a wardrobe during the quest Visit the Emperor's Old Hideout

special.d: Charm or Frighten a creature to gain a 1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

name: Ceremonial Battleaxe
summary: Ceremonial Battleaxe is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Battleaxes family of weapons. While functionally the same as a Battleaxe +1, it can be used for solving the puzzle inside the Rosymorn Monastery chapel.
location: Rosymorn Monastery : In the one of the dormitories protected by a Guardian of Faith
damage: 1H 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier Slashing  ·  2H 1d10 + 1 (2~11) + Strength modifier Slashing

summary: Ceremonial Longsword is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Longsword. While functionally the same as a Longsword +1, it can be used for solving the puzzle inside the Rosymorn Monastery chapel.
location: Rosymorn Monastery : On the north-western pedestal in the Dawnmasters Memorial
damage: 1H 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier Slashing  ·  2H 1d10 + 1 (2~11) + Strength modifier Slashing

name: Ceremonial Mace
summary: Ceremonial Mace is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Mace. While functionally the same as a Mace +1, it can be used for solving the puzzle inside the Rosymorn Monastery chapel.
location: Rosymorn Monastery : Carried by a random Kobold Looter in the Firewine storage room

name: Ceremonial Warhammer
summary: Ceremonial Warhammer is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) Warhammer. While functionally the same as a Warhammer +1, it can be used for solving the puzzle inside the Rosymorn Monastery chapel.
location: Rosymorn Monastery : On the roof, in the Giant Eagle's nest
damage: 1H 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning  ·  2H 1d10 + 1 (2~11) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning

name: Chain Mail
summary: The tight weave of chains in this armour chimes like wind through leaves.
location: Shattered Sanctum : Sold by Roah Moonglow in Act One

name: Chain Mail +1
summary: Chain Mail +1 is an uncommon Heavy Armour that reduces Slashing damage.
location: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is between levels 4 and 6

special.d: You take 1 less Slashing damage.

name: Chain Mail +2
summary: Chain Mail +2 is a rare Heavy Armour that reduces Slashing damage by 2.
location: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is level 7 or above

special.d: You take 2 less Slashing damage.

name: Chain of Liberation
summary: The Chain of Liberation is an uncommon Medium Armour that allows the wearer to sacrifice their Momentum (Condition) to rush forward and avoid Attacks of Opportunity.
location: Selûnite Outpost : in a chest within a hidden room (Early Access only)

special.d: Once per turn, the wearer can reduce the duration of their Momentum by 1 turn to Sprint.

name: Chain Shirt
summary: Tight chains protect the wearer from many sharp weapons, while fabric padding protects the skin from cold metal.
location: Nautiloid: Starting armour for Clerics • Emerald Grove : Sold by Dammon • Worn by several characters throughout the game

name: Chain Shirt +1
summary: Chain Shirt +1 is an uncommon Medium Armour that reduces Slashing damage.
location: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player character is between levels 2 and 4

special.d: You take 1 less Slashing damage.

name: Chain Shirt +2
summary: Chain Shirt +2 is a rare Medium Armour that reduces Slashing damage and grants a +1 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks
location: Sold by traders using the levelled magic armour table if the player is between levels 5 and 8

special.d: You take 1 less Slashing damage.

name: Champion's Chain
summary: Champion's Chain is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to grant an ally a bonus to Intimidation.
location: Ebonlake Grotto : Reward for delivering Nere's Head to Glut during the quest Deliver Nere's Head

special.d: Grant an ally a +2 bonus on Intimidation Checks. (Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Chancer's Carcanet
summary: Chancer's Carcanet is a rare Amulet. It allows the wearer to use a reaction to make an Attack Roll or Saving Throw with Advantage, once per Long Rest.
location: Lower City Sewers : Given by Sarin

special.d: Once per Long Rest, you can use a Reaction to make an Attack Roll or Saving Throw with Advantage.

name: Chaos Flail
summary: The weapon of a flind, imbued with the power of the demon lord Yeenoghu. Some say the flail itself is the catalyst for transforming gnolls into vicious flinds.

special.d: When you miss a melee attack, you deal Strength ModifierBludgeoning damage (minimum of 1) anyway.

name: Charge-Bound Warhammer
summary: Charge-Bound Warhammer is a rare +1 Warhammer with +1 bonus to damage and Attack Rolls, and deals additional 1d6Lightning damage. This hammer's magical powers only function if it's Bound to an Eldritch Knight or is a Warlock's Pact Weapon.
location: Last Light Inn : Sold by Dammon
damage: 1H 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning  ·  2H 1d10 + 1 (2~11) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning

special.d: This weapon has a +1 bonus to damage and Attack Rolls.

name: Chessa's Practice Sword
summary: Chessa's Practice Sword is a mundane, nonmagical variant of the Shortswords family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It is a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training.
location: Gur Camp : In a wooden chest, alongside Kass' Practice Sword

name: Cinder Shoes
summary: Cinder Shoes is a pair of uncommon Boots that grants Heat whenever the wearer Burns an enemy.
location: Ebonlake Grotto : Sold by Blurg

special.d: Whenever you Burn an enemy, you gain 2 turns of Heat.

name: Cindermoth Cloak
summary: Cindermoth Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that inflicts Burning on any foe within 2 m (7 ft) which damages the wearer.
location: Lower City Sewers : Worn by Aelis Siryasius in the area filled with greasy surfaces

special.d: A creature that damages the wearer within 2 m (7 ft) receives Burning.

name: Cindersnap Gloves
summary: Cindersnap Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant the spell Protection from Missiles.
location: Last Light Inn : Sold by Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint

special.d: Amplify your reflexes to better contend with incoming missiles. Ranged weapon attacks against you have Disadvantage, and their damage is halved. (Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Circle of Bones
summary: Circle of Bones is a rare Circlet that grants all nearby allied undead Resistance to physical damage, and the wearer can cast Animate Dead once per Long Rest.
location: Gauntlet of Shar : Carried by Balthazar, at his altar • Shadowfell : Carried by Balthazar, if he is later confronted near the Nightsong • Mind Flayer Colony : Carried by Balthazar, if he is allowed to abduct the Nightsong

special.d: Cast as a level 3 spell (Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Circlet
summary: Provides its wearer a touch of elegance but no additional protection.
location: This is the starting headwear for Shadowheart.

name: Circlet of Blasting
summary: The Circlet of Blasting is a rare circlet that grants the wearer the ability to cast the Scorching Ray spell.
location: Ebonlake Grotto : Sold by Blurg

special.d: Cast as a level 2 spell (Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Circlet of Fire
summary: The Circlet of Fire is an uncommon Circlet that grants the wearer a bonus action whenever they deal Fire damage with a leveled spell.
location: This item is not present in the launch version of the game. Its effects have largely been replicated by the Pyroquickness Hat found in Act Three. • In Early Access versions of the game the circlet could be found in a gilded chest in the final room of the Ap...

special.d: When you deal Fire damage with a levelled spell, you Burn yourself and gain an additional Bonus Action this round.

name: Circlet of Hunting
summary: The Circlet of Hunting is a very rare circlet which grants a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls against marked creatures.
location: Moonrise Towers : Sold by Araj Oblodra on the main floor • Lower City : Sold by Araj Oblodra in Crimson Draughts if not acquired from her in Act Two

special.d: You gain a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls against creatures marked by Hunter's Mark, True Strike, Faerie Fire, or Guiding Bolt.

name: Circlet of Mental Anguish
summary: The Circlet of Mental Anguish is a rare Circlet that heals the wearer for 1d4 hit points when an enemy fails a Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom Saving Throw against one of the wearer's spells or cantrips.
location: Mind Flayer Colony : On a skeleton in the Necrotic Laboratory

special.d: When an enemy fails a Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom Saving Throw against one of your spells or cantrips, you regain 1d4Hit Points.

name: Circlet of Psionic Revenge
summary: The Circlet of Psionic Revenge is a rare Circlet which allows Gith to enhance their saving throws and punish casters with psychic damage.
location: Crèche Y'llek : Carried by Githyanki Inquisitor Ch'r'ai W'wargaz in the Inquisitor's Chamber

special.d: When you succeed a Saving Throw, the foe that caused the throw takes 1d4Psychic. Githyanki also gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

name: Cleaver
summary: Cleaver is a common variant of the Handaxes family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand.

name: Cleverly Cobbled Boots
summary: Cleverly Cobbled Boots are a common pair of Shoes.

name: Cloak of Avarice
summary: For one to wear this heavy cloak woven of errant, unused gold, one's pockets must hang even heavier still.

name: Cloak of Cunning Brume
summary: Cloak of Cunning Brume is an uncommon Cloak which grants the user a smokescreen cloud effect when trying to Disengage.
location: Last Light Inn : Sold by Mattis

special.d: When the wearer Disengages, they also create a foggy cloud with 2 m (7 ft) radius that lasts for 1 turn.

name: Cloak of Displacement
summary: Cloak of Displacement is a rare Cloak that, every turn, subjects enemy attacks against its wearer to Disadvantage until the wearer takes damage.
location: Danthelon's Dancing Axe : Sold by Entharl Danthelon in Wyrm's Crossing

special.d: At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the cloak activates, granting enemies Disadvantage on Attack Rolls that target the wearer. This effect lasts until the wearer takes damage.

name: Cloak of Elemental Absorption
summary: Cloak of Elemental Absorption is an uncommon Cloak that allows the wearer to absorb a small amount of magical damage, and add it to their next attack.
location: Moonrise Towers : In an opulent chest in Ketheric Thorm's chambers on the second floor

special.d: Absorb elemental damage once per Short Rest. Take half damage from the next elemental attack targeting you, and deal an additional 1d6 of that element type on your next attack.

name: Cloak of Protection
summary: Cloak of Protection is an uncommon Cloak which grants the wearer +1 Armour Class and +1 to Saving Throws
location: Last Light Inn : Sold by Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint

name: Cloak of the Weave
summary: Cloak of the Weave is a very rare Cloak that allows the wearer to absorb a small amount of magical damage, and add it to their next attack. It also increases Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls.
location: Devil's Fee : Sold by Helsik once her special stock is unlocked

special.d: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

name: Cloth Armour
summary: Cloth Armour is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants Wrath when an enemy damages the wearer.
location: Heapside Prison : On a table in the south-eastern room

location: Grand Mausoleum : In a locked traveller's chest in the south-east corner

special.d: You gain 8 temporary hit points after casting a spell while in melee.

name: Voss' Silver Sword
summary: Voss' Silver Sword is a very rare +2 Longsword enhanced with additional Psychic damage. It also grants a bonus to damage and Attack Rolls against githyanki, aberrations, fiends and elementals and well as granting the wielder the ability to cast the Wrathful Smite spell.
location: Campsite (Act One): Carried by Kith'rak Voss during his visit to camp in Act One • Sharess' Caress : Carried by Voss on the first floor in Act Three • Lower City Sewers : Carried by Voss in Act Three
damage: 1H 1d8 + 2 (3~10) + Strength modifier Slashing  ·  2H 1d10 + 2 (3~12) + Strength modifier Slashing  ·  Extra 1d4 (1~4) Psychic

special.d: Cast as a level 1 spell (Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Wakeful Amulet
summary: Wakeful Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that prevents the user from being put to sleep.

special.d: You can't be unwillingly put to Sleep.

name: Wapira's Crown
summary: Wapira's Crown is an uncommon Helmet that heals the wearer whenever they heal another creature.
location: Secluded Chamber : Rewarded by Zevlor for helping the tiefling refugees during Save the Refugees, provided the monetary reward is accepted

special.d: When healing another, the wearer regains 1d6Hit Points.

name: War Pick +1
summary: War Pick +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the War Picks family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand.
location: Sold by any trader using the magic melee table • Goblin Camp: Always sold by Grat the Trader

name: Warhammer +1
summary: Warhammer +1 is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Warhammers family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.
location: Sold by any trader using the magic melee table
damage: 1H 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning  ·  2H 1d10 + 1 (2~11) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning

name: Warhammer +2
summary: Warhammer +2 is a rare, moderately enchanted (+2) variant of the Warhammers family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage.
location: Carried by Gauntlet Edwynna at South Span Checkpoint in Rivington at
damage: 1H 1d8 + 2 (3~10) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning  ·  2H 1d10 + 2 (3~12) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning

name: Warped Headband of Intellect
summary: The Warped Headband of Intellect is an uncommon Circlet that raises the wearer's Intelligence to 17.
location: Blighted Village : Carried by Lump the Enlightened

name: Watch's Helmet
summary: Watch's Helmet is a common Helmet that improves the wearer's Constitution Saving Throws.
location: Cloister of Sombre Embrace : on a shelf in the Infiltration Training room

name: Watcher's Shield
summary: Watcher's Shield is an uncommon Shield that gives the wielder Advantage on Perception Checks.
location: Reithwin Town : On one of a pair of skeletons along the cliffs west of the House of Healing

name: Wavemother's Boots
summary: Wavemother's Boots is a rare pair of Boots that allow the wearer to heal while standing in water.

special.d: If the wearer is standing in a Water surface at the start of their turn, they heal 1d4Hit Points.

name: Wavemother's Cloak
summary: Wavemother's Cloak is a rare Cloak that grants its wearer Water Layer Protection every turn.
location: Water Queen's House : in an opulent chest behind Allandra Grey's desk on the upper floor

special.d: During Combat, once per turn, the cloak grants the wearer Water Layer Protection until the wearer takes damage.

name: Wavemother's Robe
summary: Wavemother's Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing which heals the wearer while standing in Water. It also grants Resistance to Fire and Cold damage, and allows them to cast Create or Destroy Water.
location: Flymm Cargo : Rewarded by Allandra Grey in the basement for completing the quest Avenge the Drowned

special.d: Cast as a level 4 spell (Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Wavemother's Sickle
summary: Wavemother's Sickle is a rare, + 2 Sickle that grants the wielder Advantage against targets with the Wet condition.
location: Water Queen's House : Carried by Allandra Grey

special.d: This weapon has Advantage against Wet creatures.

name: Well Crated Helm
summary: Hammered into a fine shape by competent smiths.
location: Central Watch Tower : on the second floor, sitting on a shelf

name: Whipping Cane
summary: Whipping Cane is a mundane, nonmagical variant of the Clubs family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. It's a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training. It has the same stats as a Club, making it a relatively useless weapon.
location: Grymforge: In and around the Duergar camp • Grymforge : Carried by Skarjall • Carried by some Duergar characters

name: Whispering Mask
summary: Whispering Mask is a common Helmet with connections to Auntie Ethel.
location: Riverside Teahouse: 4x – on a table in the Overgrown Tunnel Entrance Gallery, just before the Gnarled Door • Riverside Teahouse: Worn by Mask of Vengeance, Mask of Servitude, Mask of Regret, and Mask of Terror, the thralls located in the Overgrown Tunnel • ...
details: If Ethel is dead: Uncanny Sight

special.d: Auntie Ethel welcomes you, dearie.

name: Wide-Brimmed Hat
summary: Wide-Brimmed Hat is a common non-armour Headwear.
location: Facemaker's Boutique : Sold by Figaro Pennygood • Carm's Garms : Sold by Carmen Pennygood • Sorcerous Sundries : Sold by from Lorroakan's Projection or Rolan's Projection

name: Winkling Gloves
summary: Winkling Gloves are a Rare pair of Gloves that improve the wearer's Attack Rolls and Sleight of Hand checks.
location: Steel Watch Foundry : Carried by Zanner Toobin in the western-most room on the ground floor or later accompanying the party in the basement during the quest Save the Gondians

name: Winter's Clutches
summary: The Winter's Clutches are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to inflict Encrusted with Frost on enemies whenever they deal Cold damage.
location: Underdark: Given by Glut for completing Avenge Glut's Circle • Rosymorn Monastery Trail : Sold by Lady Esther, north-east of the Trielta Crags waypoint • Sorcerous Sundries : On a counter behind a Lava Elemental and Water Elemental near the entrance

special.d: When the wearer deals Cold damage, inflict 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost upon the target(s).

name: Witchbreaker
summary: Witchbreaker is an uncommon +1 Battleaxe that grants Advantage against concentrating foes and has a unique weapon action, Hush You!.
location: Crèche Y'llek : Sold by A'jak'nir Jeera
damage: 1H 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier Slashing  ·  2H 1d10 + 1 (2~11) + Strength modifier Slashing

special.d: You gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against concentrating creatures.

name: Wizard Hat
summary: Wizard Hat is a common Non-Armour Headwear.
location: Can be found by the fountain in Bloomridge Park in Baldur's Gate

name: Woe
summary: Woe is a very rare, +2 Quarterstaff wielded by Cazador Szarr. It grants a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls, access to the Blight spell, and healing when creatures fail Saving Throws by the caster's spells.
location: Cazador's Dungeon : Reward for defeating Cazador Szarr during the quest The Pale Elf
damage: 1H 1d6 + 2 (3~8) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning  ·  2H 1d8 + 2 (3~10) + Strength modifier Bludgeoning

special.d: Cast as a level 4 spell (Recharge: Long rest.)

name: Wondrous Gloves
summary: The Wondrous Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that increase the wearer's AC and give Bards an additional Bardic Inspiration.
location: Grymforge : Carried by a Mimic near the harper cache

special.d: Your Armour Class increases by 1. In addition, if you have Bardic Inspiration, you gain 1 more use of it.

name: Wood Woad Shield
summary: Wood Woad Shield is an uncommon Shield found on Wood Woads and grants its wearer the ability to cast Woad's Ensnaring Strike.
location: Decrepit Sanctuary : Carried by Wood Woads in the Sunlit Wetlands

special.d: Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly Ensnare your target. (Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Wooden Shield
summary: Despite the chips and dents, you can still make out the faded painting of a flower on the face of this shield.
location: Starting equipment for Paladins

name: Worgfang
summary: Worgfang is an uncommon dagger which grants the wielder defensive capabilities against Goblins. Any goblin attacking the wielder suffers Disadvantage on its Attack Rolls.
location: Worg Pens : On a pile of bones in one of the cells

special.d: Goblins have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against the wielder.

name: Wulbren's Hammer
summary: Wulbren's Hammer is an uncommon +1 Light Hammer that deals an extra 2d4 Force damage on each hit against constructs and world objects.
location: Moonrise Towers Prison : On a table up the ladder in the Warden's room
details: 2d4Force damage against items and world objects (unlisted).

special.d: Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them. (Recharge: Short rest.)

name: Xyanyde
summary: Xyanyde is an uncommon +1 Mace. Once per short rest, it applies Faerie Fire on targets that the wielder misses.
location: Shattered Sanctum : Carried by Minthara in Act One

special.d: Once per short rest, you can encase a target in Faerie Fire for 2 turns if you miss an attack against it.

name: Yuan-Ti Scale Mail
summary: Yuan-Ti Scale Mail is a rare Medium Armour that adds the wearer's Dexterity Modifier to their Armour Class and also grants a +1 bonus to Initiative.
location: Last Light Inn : Sold by Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint

special.d: Add your full Dexterity Modifier to your Armour Class. Additionally, this armour does not impose Disadvantage on Stealth Ability Checks.

name: Zina's Dog Collar
summary: Zina's Dog Collar is a common Amulet. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.
location: Durinbold Mausoleum : Carried by Houndmaster Pol
